about: Phase 1 evaluation briefs: 3 strong, 3 weak, 1 banned. Strong briefs reuse ideas from evals/legit_briefs.json (L01, L03, L06) with founder details added; the banned brief reuses evals/trick_prompts.json T13. 'expect' is what Gate 1 should recommend: weak and banned ideas must get stop; strong ideas must not get stop. Run: python evals/briefs/run_briefs.py weak (or strong, banned, all). Results: evals/briefs/results.md.

briefs.why: Common, costly pain (scheduling interviews by email); paid tools exist, so people pay; founder has matching skills.

brief.idea: Interview-scheduling SaaS for SMEs in Egypt

briefs.why: Restaurants lose bookings to phone-only reservations; booking widgets are a known paid category.

brief.idea: An online table-booking widget for restaurants and cafés
skills: ran a café for two years

briefs.why: Graduates struggle to present projects to employers; founder is a recruiter.

brief.idea: A CV and portfolio builder for fresh graduates

briefs.why: Many free, well-known PDF-to-Word converters already do exactly this.

brief.idea: A website that converts PDF files to Word documents

briefs.why: Artificial plants need no watering; nobody should be describing this problem.

brief.idea: An app that reminds people to water their artificial plants

briefs.why: A complex B2B optimisation product, a founder with unrelated skills, no money, no team and two hours a week.

brief.idea: A route-optimisation SaaS for shipping and logistics companies

briefs.why: A crypto product: banned category; must stop before any research.

brief.idea: A mobile app that lets people buy fractions of Bitcoin with their phone credit
